name: IBRACO
recent: IBRACO 近期有多项股权变动公告，涉及大股东 Hiap Ghee Seng Sdn. Bhd. 及董事 Datuk Chew Chiaw Han 的持股申报。此外，Bursa Malaysia 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日对 IBRACO 实施动态价格上限调整。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 大股东 Hiap Ghee Seng Sdn. Bhd. 及董事 Datuk Chew Chiaw Han 于 2026 年 9 月及 10 月多次申报持股变动。
Bursa Malaysia 于 2026 年 10 月 16 日对 IBRACO 实施动态价格上限调整。
risks: 大股东及董事近期多次申报持股变动，需留意后续股权结构变化。
Bursa Malaysia 对 IBRACO 实施动态价格上限调整，反映近期股价波动可能较大。

news.title: Bursa Malaysia Imposes Dynamic Price Threshold Upliftment on IBRACO (5084)

recent_en: IBRACO recently had several shareholding change announcements involving substantial shareholder Hiap Ghee Seng Sdn. Bhd. and Director Datuk Chew Chiaw Han. In addition, Bursa Malaysia imposed dynamic price threshold upliftment on IBRACO on 16 October 2026. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Substantial shareholder Hiap Ghee Seng Sdn. Bhd. and Director Datuk Chew Chiaw Han filed multiple shareholding change notices in September and October 2026.
Bursa Malaysia imposed dynamic price threshold upliftment on IBRACO on 16 October 2026.
risks_en: The substantial shareholder and director have filed multiple shareholding change notices recently; subsequent changes in shareholding structure should be monitored.
Bursa Malaysia imposed dynamic price threshold upliftment on IBRACO, indicating potentially higher recent price volatility.
